== Template:Item ==

Infobox template for displaying item information on wiki pages.

Item articles set inline parameters (the legacy rendering path). The '''Map''' row
is generated automatically from <code>stablekey</code> and links to the item's
location on the [https://erenshor.compendiums.org/map interactive map]. Passing
<code>lua=1</code> switches the infobox to the Lua/Cargo rendering path reserved
for the future article cutover; omit it for the legacy inline-param infobox
described below.

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Required !! Description
|-
| '''title''' || Yes || Item name (displayed as title)
|-
| '''stablekey''' || No || Canonical item key, e.g. <code>item:gen - bread</code>. Generates the interactive-map link in the Map row.
|-
| '''image''' || Yes || Item icon: <code><nowiki>[[File:Item Name.png]]</nowiki></code>
|-
| '''imagecaption''' || No || Caption for the image
|-
| '''type''' || Yes || Item type link, e.g., <code><nowiki>[[Weapons|Weapon]]</nowiki></code>
|-
| '''vendorsource''' || No || NPCs that sell this item
|-
| '''source''' || No || Enemies that drop this item
|-
| '''othersource''' || No || Other ways to obtain the item
|-
| '''questsource''' || No || Quests that reward this item
|-
| '''relatedquest''' || No || Quests that require this item
|-
| '''craftsource''' || No || Crafting recipes that produce this item
|-
| '''componentfor''' || No || Recipes this item is used in
|-
| '''relic''' || No || Set to "True" if this is a [[Relic]] item
|-
| '''classes''' || No || Classes that can use this item
|-
| '''effects''' || No || General stat effects (for equipment)
|-
| '''casttime''' || No || Casting time for abilities
|-
| '''duration''' || No || Effect duration
|-
| '''cooldown''' || No || Cooldown time
|-
| '''effect''' || No || Click-to-use activatable effect
|-
| '''worneffect''' || No || Passive worn effect when equipped
|-
| '''proceffect''' || No || Chance-on-hit proc effect
|-
| '''buffgiven''' || No || Buff provided by this item
|-
| '''taughtspell''' || No || Spell taught by this spellbook
|-
| '''taughtskill''' || No || Skill taught by this skillbook
|-
| '''spelltype''' || No || Type of spell (for spellbooks)
|-
| '''skilltype''' || No || Type of skill (for skillbooks)
|-
| '''manacost''' || No || Mana cost for activatable effects
|-
| '''disposable''' || No || Set to "True" if item is consumed on use
|-
| '''produces''' || No || Items produced by this crafting recipe
|-
| '''ingredients''' || No || Ingredients required for crafting
|-
| '''description''' || No || Item flavor text/lore
|-
| '''buy''' || No || Purchase price in gold
|-
| '''sell''' || No || Sell price in gold
|-
| '''guaranteeddrops''' || No || Items guaranteed to drop from this container
|-
| '''droprates''' || No || Drop rate information
|-
| '''lua''' || No || Set to <code>1</code> to render via the Lua/Cargo path (reserved for the future article cutover). Leave unset for the legacy infobox.
|}

=== Examples ===

==== Quest Item with Activatable Effect ====

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item
|title=Keeper's Lantern
|image=[[File:Keeper's Lantern.png]]
|type=[[Quest Items|Quest Item]]
|questsource={{QuestLink|Delivering the Light}}
|relic=True
|description=Rest a while in the glow of the flame, and allow the memory of its light to guide you home.
|effect={{AbilityLink|Light of the Lantern}}
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item
|title=Keeper's Lantern
|image=[[File:Keeper's Lantern.png]]
|type=[[Quest Items|Quest Item]]
|questsource={{QuestLink|Delivering the Light}}
|relic=True
|description=Rest a while in the glow of the flame, and allow the memory of its light to guide you home.
|effect={{AbilityLink|Light of the Lantern}}
}}

|classes=Druid, Arcanist, Stormcaller
|damage=1
|delay=3.0

}}
